title: Fix Email upgrade writing during no-transaction upgrade test
summary: Email Installer no longer re-registers email tables based on allowed-table row presence, only checking upgrade tags or forced refresh to prevent unwanted database writes during upgrade tests.
key_points: Removes the IsAllowedTable trigger that caused unnecessary registration of email tables
Registration now only occurs when upgrade tags are missing or on forced refresh
Prevents Retention Policy Log Entry writes that violated no-transaction test requirements
Tag-based behavior from previous change remains intact
Users can still refresh allowed tables manually via Retention Policy Setup
